projectDescription: A LangGraph-powered multi-agent system that automates the end-to-end hiring workflow — from resume parsing and job description analysis through multi-round interview generation to candidate evaluation and email drafting.
keyFeatures: Supervisor-orchestrated multi-agent pipeline using LangGraph StateGraph
Automated resume parsing extracts structured candidate profiles from PDF
Job description analysis identifies required skills, seniority, and hiring priorities
Candidate-JD matching scores fit across technical, experience, leadership, and communication dimensions
Multi-round interview question generation: HR, Technical (Principal level), and CEO rounds
Candidate research agent provides strategic interview insights and preparation recommendations
Final evaluation agent synthesizes all agent outputs into an overall hiring verdict
Email agent drafts personalized outreach emails for each interviewer
Loop-detection guardrails in the supervisor prevent infinite agent cycles
Pluggable local LLM support via LM Studio and LangChain's ChatOpenAI interface
publicApiSurface: app (graph.workflow) — compiled LangGraph app, entry point for streaming the hiring workflow
HiringState (graph.state) — TypedDict defining the full shared workflow state
supervisor_agent(state) — orchestrator that routes between agents and detects loops
resume_parser_agent(state) — extracts structured candidate profile from resume text
jd_analysis_agent(state) — extracts structured JD requirements from raw job description
matching_agent(state) — scores candidate-JD fit across multiple dimensions
hr_interview_agent(state) — produces 15 HR interview questions with evaluation criteria
technical_interview_agent(state) — produces 20 technical questions with expected answers
ceo_interview_agent(state) — produces 10 executive-level questions with behavioral indicators
evaluation_agent(state) — synthesizes all data into a final hiring recommendation
email_agent(state) — drafts HR, technical, and CEO interviewer emails
extract_pdf_text(path) — utility to extract text from a resume PDF using PyMuPDF
